`text-overflow.pptx` is a synthetic three-slide repro for PR #295, with Arial text and gray outlines showing the stored shape rectangles. It contains no private corpus material.

| Slide | Case | Expected result with Liberation Sans |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Top overflow, object 2, blue `#2040B0` | 48 pt text paints below its 32 px box. |
| 1 | `spAutoFit`, object 3, green `#147D40` | 48 pt / 64 px, instead of main's 24 pt / 32 px. |
| 1 | Center and bottom anchors, objects 4–5 | A 73.59375 px line starts at y=269.203125 and y=248.40625 respectively, around boxes starting at y=290. |
| 1 | `normAutofit` and fitting controls, objects 6–7 | Normal autofit still shrinks; fitting text remains 48 pt. |
| 2 | Rotation, vertical flip, inherited `spAutoFit` | Full-size text remains clickable outside its box, using the stored shape's transform pivot. |
| 3 | Vertical clip, horizontal clip, ellipsis, inherited clip | Preserve the existing clipped rendering and exclude hidden text from hit testing. |
| 3 | Explicit overflow overriding inherited clip | Text paints outside the box and remains clickable. |

The renderer tests also narrow the first shape to 10 px to exercise a line wider than its box. The stored shape geometry and document text are unchanged by rendering.

`text-overflow.before.png` was rendered on main `069e4d66` (byte-identical to `2c90c17f`); `text-overflow.after.png` uses this branch. Both use the repository's Liberation Sans font. The 48 pt lines are 73.59375 px high, with a 57.9375 px baseline offset. Main clips them at the box boundary; the fixed renderer paints each complete line.

The raster and native tests retain the enclosing chart clip while allowing text to overflow its own box. Schema v11 retains explicit body overflow settings; the v9 and v10 collaboration fixtures were generated by their respective main versions from this deck. Defaults stay omitted from JSON, and no-edit saves preserve every ZIP part.

The semantics follow Microsoft's [shape autofit](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.drawing.shapeautofit) and [body properties](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.drawing.bodyproperties) documentation. Ellipsis retains the existing clipped fallback; this change does not synthesize an ellipsis glyph.
